stages.name: Commerce architecture
stages.detail: Commerce-first hierarchy, Product/Variant commerce truth, metaobjects for creative context.

stages.name: Shopify storefront implementation
stages.detail: Theme 2.0 storefront, PDP, PLP, artist/archive pages, cart drawer, search and creators.

stages.name: CRO + mobile + accessibility hardening
stages.detail: Explicit size selection, sticky mobile CTA, checkout handoff, unavailable sizes, focus handling and native filters.

stages.name: Production hardening
stages.detail: Safe fallbacks, structured data, metadata, pagination and internal preflight.

stages.name: Analytics instrumentation
stages.detail: Shopify Customer Events ownership + 8 misca:* custom events. Real pixel QA still pending.

stages.name: GitHub source + official Theme Check
stages.detail: Dedicated repository, main canonical, official Theme Check green on PR and main.

stages.name: Safe Shopify preview pipeline
stages.detail: Unpublished pre/post role checks, strict push, evidence summary and no live-publish path.

stages.name: One-time MISCA Preview bootstrap
stages.detail: Creates the first unpublished theme without needing a theme ID; returns ID and preview/editor URLs.

stages.name: Shopify runtime configuration
stages.detail: Configure SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN and SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE in GitHub Actions.

stages.name: First persistent Shopify preview
stages.detail: Run Bootstrap Shopify preview theme after runtime configuration.

stages.name: Storefront QA
stages.detail: 40 checks across Home, PLP, PDP, cart, search, mobile, accessibility and runtime behavior.

stages.name: Analytics QA
stages.detail: 12 checks covering standard Customer Events and misca:* custom events.

stages.name: Product Ready — Raíz + Ola
stages.detail: Blank, fit, print, wash, factual specs, real COGS, photography and sellable inventory must be validated physically.

stages.name: Controlled launch
stages.detail: Requires Product Ready + real preview QA + E2E commerce + analytics QA.

nextGate.name: SHOPIFY CONFIG
actions: Prefer private repository visibility during build.
Configure GitHub Actions secret SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE with the .myshopify.com domain.
Run Bootstrap Shopify preview theme once.
Copy the returned theme ID into SHOPIFY_PREVIEW_THEME_ID.
Run the normal Deploy Shopify preview theme workflow and start QA.
